inclusion_rule: Sentence or phrase recognition from silently articulated speech measured by body-worn or contact non-video sensors (EMG, inertial, strain, triboelectric, magnetic, EMA, ultrasound, active acoustic); the design compared is how a sentence is decoded: whole-sentence classification, HMM decoding, CTC, or attention sequence-to-sequence. Boundary: lip video, imagined speech, overt-only and synthesis-only studies are outside; a study counts under every decoder its full text names (upper bound, related-work mentions included); versions count once.
